'''March 2001 Melbourne tournament (25 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 25 March 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1968">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-27-melbourne-australia-sunday-25-03-01d1968/ melbourne-australia-sunday-25-03-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 27 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-27-melbourne-australia-sunday-25-03-01d1968/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
